children: Turkey’s annual inflation rate rose to 29.77% in October 2026, above market expectations of 29.56% and picking up from a near five-year low of 29.73% in the previous month.

The latest figure raises doubts about the prospect of another interest-rate cut before year-end, following the central bank’s decision to lower its benchmark interest rate by 100 basis points to 36% in October, its first reduction since January amid subdued demand and slowing economic activity.
The central bank, however, will have November inflation data at its disposal before making its next policy decision.
Price increases accelerated particularly in food and non-alcoholic beverages (27.73% vs 27.62% in September), housing (40.24% vs 39.99%), and transportation (36.39% vs 35.1%).
In contrast, costs eased for alcoholic beverages and tobacco (28.73% vs 31.6%) and various goods and services (20.86% vs 21.88%).
On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose to a six-month high of 2.58% from 1.84% in September.

title: Turkey Inflation Rate Above Expectations
